sanskrit: svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā | indrāya pātave sutaḥ ||
english: Flow, O Soma, with thy sweetest, most exhilarating stream; thou art pressed out for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇir abhi yonim ayohatam | druṇā sadastham āsadat ||
english: The slayer of Rākṣasas, beholder of all beings, settles upon the iron-firm birthplace, taking his seat in the wooden vessel.

sanskrit: varivodhātamo bhava maṁhiṣṭho vṛtrahantamaḥ | parṣi rādho maghonām ||
english: Be thou the greatest giver of freedom, the most bountiful, the most potent slayer of Vṛtra; convey to us the wealth of the munificent ones.

sanskrit: abhy arṣa mahānāṁ devānāṁ vītim andhāsā | abhi vājam uta śravaḥ ||
english: Flow forth with the Soma-juice to the feast of the great gods; flow forth for food and for renown.

sanskrit: tvām acchā carāmasi tad id arthaṁ dive-dive | indo tve na āśasaḥ ||
english: To thee, O Indu, day by day we draw near with this purpose alone; our desires rest in thee.

sanskrit: punāti te parisrutaṁ somaṁ sūryasya duhitā | vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā ||
english: The daughter of the Sun purifies thy flowing Soma with her eternal fleece, forever and ever.

sanskrit: tam īm aṇvīḥ samarya ā gṛbhṇanti yoṣaṇo daśa | svasāraḥ pārye divi ||
english: Ten nimble fingers take hold of him, his sisters, at the proper celestial time — the ten divine maidens seize him.

sanskrit: tam īṁ hinvanty agruvo dhamanti bākuraṁ dṛtim | tridhātu vāraṇam madhu ||
english: The unmarried maidens urge him on; they blow into the resounding skin-bag — the honey that possesses three stations and is worthy of being held back.

sanskrit: abhīmam aghnyā uta śrīṇanti dhenavaḥ śiśum | somam indrāya pātave ||
english: The holy, unslayable milk-cows also mix him — this child, this Soma — for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: asyed indro madeṣv ā viśvā vṛtrāṇi jighnate | śūro maghā ca maṁhate ||
english: By these exhilarations of Soma, Indra strikes down all the Vṛtras; the hero bestows great gifts and wealth.

sanskrit: pavasva devavīr ati pavitraṁ soma raṁhyā | indram indo vṛṣā viśa ||
english: Flow forth swiftly, O Soma, thou who art the hero of the gods, past the filter; O Indu, O bull, enter into Indra.

sanskrit: ā vacyasva mahi psaro vṛṣendo dyumnavattamaḥ | ā yoniṁ dharṇasiḥ sadaḥ ||
english: Fill thyself full with the great food, O manly Indu, most abundantly glorious; take thy seat, thou who art firm by nature, upon thy birthplace.

sanskrit: adhukṣata priyam madhu dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ | apo vasiṣṭa sukratuḥ ||
english: The stream of the pressed one, the wise ordainer, has milked forth the beloved honey; clothed in the waters he stands, he of good resolution.

sanskrit: mahāntaṁ tvā mahīr anv āpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ | yad gobhir vāsayiṣyase ||
english: The great waters, the great rivers, flow after thee, the great one, when thou art about to clothe thyself with the cows' milk.

sanskrit: samudro apsu māmṛje viṣṭambho dharuṇo divaḥ | somaḥ pavitre asmayuḥ ||
english: The ocean has cleansed itself in the waters; Soma, the support, the upholder of heaven, desiring us, flows through the filter.

sanskrit: acikradad vṛṣā harir mahān mitro na darśataḥ | saṁ sūryeṇa rocate ||
english: The great tawny bull has cried aloud, beautiful as Mitra; he shines together with the Sun.

sanskrit: giras ta inda ojasā marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ | yābhir madāya śumbhase ||
english: The praises, O Indu, of those who are busy working are polished bright for thee with power — those praises with which thou adornest thyself for intoxication.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā madāya ghṛṣvaya u lokakṛtnum īmahe | tava praśastayo mahīḥ ||
english: We implore thee — thee who art impetuous for ecstasy, who art the maker of space; great are thy praises.

sanskrit: asmabhyam indav indrayur madhvaḥ pavasva dhārayā | parjanyo vṛṣṭimām̐ iva ||
english: Flow for us, O Indu, longing for Indra, with a stream of sweetness — as Parjanya laden with rain.

sanskrit: goṣā indo nṛṣā asy aśvasā vājasā uta | ātmā yajñasya pūrvyaḥ ||
english: Thou art the winner of cows, O Indu, the winner of men, the winner of horses, the winner of food; thou art the primordial soul of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: eṣa devo amartyaḥ parṇavīr iva dīyati | abhi droṇāny āsadam ||
english: This immortal god flies like a bird with wings; he settles upon the wooden vessels.

sanskrit: eṣa devo vipā kṛto 'ti hvarāṁsi dhāvati | pavamāno adābhyaḥ ||
english: This god, fashioned by the inspired sage, runs past the crooked places; the Pavamāna is not to be deceived.

sanskrit: eṣa devo vipanyubhiḥ pavamāna ṛtāyubhiḥ | harir vājāya mṛjyate ||
english: This god, the Pavamāna, is wiped clean by the inspired praisers, by those who live according to Ṛta; the tawny one is cleansed for the winning of prizes.

sanskrit: eṣa viśvāni vāryā śūro yann iva satvaḥ | pavamānaḥ siṣāsati ||
english: This Pavamāna, like a warrior hero advancing, strives to win all desirable things.

sanskrit: eṣa devo ratharyati pavamāno daśasyati | āviṣ kṛṇoti vagvanum ||
english: This god, the Pavamāna, moves like a chariot-warrior; he serves the generous patron; he makes the praiseful bard manifest.

sanskrit: eṣa vipair abhiṣṭuto 'po devo vi gāhate | dadhad ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
english: This god, praised by the sages, plunges through the waters, bestowing treasures upon the pious worshipper.

sanskrit: eṣa divaṁ vi dhāvati tiro rajāṁsi dhārayā | pavamānaḥ kanikradat ||
english: This Pavamāna runs through heaven, passing through the realms of air with his stream, roaring aloud.

sanskrit: eṣa divaṁ vy āsarat tiro rajāṁsy aspṛtaḥ | pavamānaḥ svadhvaraḥ ||
english: This Pavamāna has coursed through heaven, untouched, passing through the aerial realms; he is the lord of the proper rite.

sanskrit: eṣa pratnena janmanā devo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ | hariḥ pavitre arṣati ||
english: This god, pressed out of old for the gods, flows with his ancient birth through the filter, the tawny one.

sanskrit: eṣa u sya puruvrato jajñāno janayann iṣaḥ | dhārayā pavate sutaḥ ||
english: This same one, of many ordinances, being born and generating nourishments, flows, when pressed, with his stream.

sanskrit: sanā ca soma jeṣi ca pavamāna mahi śravaḥ | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: Both of old hast thou won, O Soma Pavamāna, and thou dost win great renown; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: sanā jyotiḥ sanā svar viśvā ca soma saubhagā | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: Of old hast thou won the light, of old the sun, and all good fortune, O Soma; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: sanā dakṣam uta kratum apa soma mṛdho jahi | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: Of old hast thou won power and wisdom; slay the enemies, O Soma; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: pavītāraḥ punītana somam indrāya pātave | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: O ye purifiers, purify the Soma for Indra to drink; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: tvaṁ sūrye na ā bhaja tava kratvā tavo 'tibhiḥ | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: Give us our share in the Sun, through thy wisdom, through thy help; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: tava kratvā tavo 'tibhir jyok paśyema sūryam | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: Through thy wisdom, through thy aid, may we behold the Sun for a long time; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: abhy arṣa svāyudha soma dvibarhasaṁ rayim | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: Flow forth, O Soma, well-armed, with wealth that is doubly great; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: abhy arṣānapacyuto rayiṁ samatsu sāsahiḥ | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: Flow forth, undiminished, having conquered wealth in battles; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: tvāṁ yajñair avīvṛdhan pavamāna vidharmaṇi | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: The sacrifices have exalted thee, O Pavamāna, in thy distributive ordinance; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: rayiṁ naś citram aśvinam indo viśvāyum ā bhara | athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
english: Bring to us, O Indu, brilliant wealth abounding in horses and full of all life; so now make us more prosperous.

sanskrit: samiddho viśvatas patiḥ pavamāno vi rājati | prīṇan vṛṣā kanikradat ||
english: Kindled, the lord of all quarters, Pavamāna reigns radiantly; the bull gladdens all, roaring aloud.

sanskrit: tanūnapāt pavamānaḥ śṛṅge śiśāno arṣati | antarikṣeṇa rārajat ||
english: Tanūnapāt Pavamāna flows, sharpening his two horns, shining brilliantly through the atmosphere.

sanskrit: īḷenyaḥ pavamāno rayir vi rājati dyumān | madhor dhārābhir ojasā ||
english: The Pavamāna who is worthy of invocation shines forth, luminous treasure, with streams of sweetness and with might.

sanskrit: barhiḥ prācīnam ojasā pavamānaḥ stṛṇan hariḥ | deveṣu deva īyate ||
english: Spreading the eastward-laid sacred grass with his might, the tawny Pavamāna, a god among gods, is invoked.

sanskrit: ud atair jihate bṛhad dvāro devīr hiraṇyayīḥ | pavamānena suṣṭutāḥ ||
english: The divine golden doors swing open wide with a great sound, praised by the Pavamāna.

sanskrit: suśilpe bṛhatī mahī pavamāno vṛṣaṇyati | naktoṣāsā na darśate ||
english: The two great ones, splendidly adorned with beauty — Night and Dawn, like two who do not see each other — Pavamāna desires them as a bull.

sanskrit: ubhā devā nṛcakṣasā hotārā daivyā huve | pavamāna indro vṛṣā ||
english: I invoke both the divine priests, beholders of men: Pavamāna and the bull Indra.

sanskrit: bhāratī pavamānasya sarasvatīḷā mahī | imaṁ no yajñam ā gaman tisro devīḥ supeśasaḥ ||
english: May Bhāratī of the Pavamāna, great Sarasvatī, and Iḷā — may the three fair-formed goddesses come to this our sacrifice.

sanskrit: tvaṣṭāram agrajāṁ gopām puroyāvānam ā huve | indur indro vṛṣā hariḥ pavamānaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
english: I invoke Tvaṣṭṛ, the firstborn, the protector, the foremost mover; Indu is Indra, the bull, the tawny Pavamāna, Prajāpati.

sanskrit: vanaspatim pavamāna madhvā sam aṅgdhi dhārayā | sahasravalśaṁ haritam bhrājamānaṁ hiraṇyayam ||
english: O Pavamāna, anoint the lord of the forest with thy stream of sweetness — the thousand-branched, the green, the glittering, the golden one.

sanskrit: viśve devāḥ svāhākṛtim pavamānasyā gata | vāyur bṛhaspatiḥ sūryo 'gnir indraḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||
english: Come, all ye gods, to the Svāhā offering of the Pavamāna — Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Sūrya, Agni, and Indra together, in union.

sanskrit: mandrayā soma dhārayā vṛṣā pavasva devayuḥ | avyo vāreṣv asmayuḥ ||
english: Flow, O Soma, with thy gladdening stream, O bull, longing for the gods, desiring us through the woollen filters.

sanskrit: abhi tyam madyam madam indav indra iti kṣara | abhi vājino arvataḥ ||
english: Flow, O Indu, toward that exhilarating intoxication, crying 'Indra!'; flow toward the vigorous steeds.

sanskrit: abhi tyam pūrvyam madaṁ suvāno arṣa pavitra ā | abhi vājam uta śravaḥ ||
english: Pressed out, flow, O Soma, through the filter toward that primordial exhilaration; flow toward food and renown.

sanskrit: anu drapsāsa indava āpo na pravatāsaran | punānā indram āśata ||
english: The Soma-drops, the Indus, have flowed after their path like waters along a slope; purifying themselves, they have entered Indra.

sanskrit: yam atyam iva vājinam mṛjanti yoṣaṇo daśa | vane krīḻantam atyavim ||
english: Him whom the ten maidens wipe clean like a race-horse full of vigour — him who sports like a swift sheep in the forest.

sanskrit: taṁ gobhir vṛṣaṇaṁ rasam madāya devavītaye | sutam bharāya saṁ sṛja ||
english: Mingle the sap of that bull together with the cows' milk, when pressed, for the exhilaration and the delight of the gods; bring him.

sanskrit: devo devāya dhārayendrāya pavate sutaḥ | payo yad asya pīpayat ||
english: A god flows by his stream for a god; when pressed, he flows for Indra, having swelled with his milk.

sanskrit: ātmā yajñasya raṁhyā suṣvāṇaḥ pavate sutaḥ | pratnaṁ ni pāti kāvyam ||
english: The soul of the sacrifice, pressed out, flows swiftly, well pressed; he preserves the ancient wisdom-poetry.

sanskrit: evā punāna indrayur madam madiṣṭha vītaye | guhā cid dadhiṣe giraḥ ||
english: Thus purifying thyself, longing for Indra, O most exhilarating, for the delight — even in the secret place thou holdest the praises.

sanskrit: asṛgram indavaḥ pathā dharmann ṛtasya suśriyaḥ | vidānā asya yojanam ||
english: The Indu-drops, beautiful, have been set flowing along the path, along the ordinance of Ṛta, knowing the harnessing thereof.

sanskrit: pra dhārā madhvo agriyo mahīr apo vi gāhate | havir haviṣṣu vandyaḥ ||
english: The foremost stream of sweetness plunges through the great waters; he is worthy of praise among oblations, the best of oblations.

sanskrit: pra yujo vāco agriyo vṛṣāva cakradad vane | sadmābhi satyo adhvaraḥ ||
english: The foremost driver of words has roared like a bull in the forest; he is truly the one who pervades the proper rite with his seat.

sanskrit: pari yat kāvyā kavir nṛmṇā vasāno arṣati | svar vājī siṣāsati ||
english: When the seer, clothed in his poetic powers and in heroic might, flows around, the swift steed strives to win the sun.

sanskrit: pavamāno abhi spṛdho viśo rājeva sīdati | yad īm ṛṇvanti vedhāsaḥ ||
english: Pavamāna settles upon the peoples who contend against him, like a king, when the ordaining priests set him in motion.

sanskrit: avyo vāre pari priyo harir vaneṣu sīdati | rebho vanuṣyate matī ||
english: The beloved tawny one rests in the woollen filter, rests in the wooden vessels; the singing priest wins favour through his song of praise.

sanskrit: sa vāyum indram aśvinā sākam madena gacchati | raṇā yo asya dharmabhiḥ ||
english: He who delights in Soma's ordinances goes together with his exhilaration to Vāyu, to Indra, to the Aśvins.

sanskrit: ā mitrāvaruṇā bhagam madhvaḥ pavanta ūrmayaḥ | vidānā asya śakabhiḥ ||
english: Toward Mitra and Varuṇa, toward Bhaga, the waves of sweetness flow purifying, knowing his powers.

sanskrit: asmabhyaṁ rodasī rayim madhvo vājasya sātaye | śravo vasūni saṁ jitam ||
english: O Heaven and Earth, win for us wealth and the sweetness of Soma for the gaining of food-prizes — renown and all good things.

sanskrit: ete somā abhi priyam indrasya kāmam akṣaran | vardhanto asya vīryam ||
english: These Somas have flowed toward the beloved desire of Indra, increasing his heroic might.

sanskrit: punānāsaś camūṣado gacchanto vāyum aśvinā | te no dhāntu suvīryam ||
english: They, the purifying ones who sit in the pressing vessels, going toward Vāyu, toward the Aśvins — may they grant us true heroic power.

sanskrit: indrasya soma rādhase punāno hārdi codaya | ṛtasya yonim āsadam ||
english: O Soma, purifying thyself for the gift of Indra, stimulate his heart; take thy seat in the birthplace of Ṛta.

sanskrit: mṛjanti tvā daśa kṣipo hinvanti sapta dhītayaḥ | anu viprā amādiṣuḥ ||
english: Ten nimble fingers cleanse thee; seven songs of praise urge thee on; after thee the inspired ones have rejoiced.

sanskrit: devebhyas tvā madāya kaṁ sṛjānam ati meṣyaḥ | saṁ gobhir vāsayāmasi ||
english: Thee, released for the exhilaration of the gods, O thou who dost spring over the filter — we clothe thee with the cows' milk.

sanskrit: punānaḥ kalaśeṣv ā vastrāṇy aruṣo hariḥ | pari gavyāny avyata ||
english: Purifying himself, he, the ruddy tawny one, is clothed in garments in the bowls; he has wrapped himself about with the dairy-gifts.

sanskrit: maghona ā pavasva no jahi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ | indo sakhāyam ā viśa ||
english: Flow for us, O lord of bounty; slay all enemies; O Indu, enter into thy friend.

sanskrit: vṛṣṭiṁ divaḥ pari srava dyumnam pṛthivyā adhi | saho naḥ soma pṛtsu dhāḥ ||
english: Flow from heaven as rain; lay glory upon the earth; establish our might, O Soma, in battles.

sanskrit: nṛcakṣasaṁ tvā vayam indrapītaṁ svarvidam | bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam ||
english: May we partake of thee, the beholder of men, drunk by Indra, the finder of the sun — of thy offspring and nourishment.

sanskrit: pari priyā divaḥ kavir vayāṁsi napyor hitaḥ | suvāno yāti kavikratuḥ ||
english: The beloved seer of heaven, placed amid the two young women's limbs, pressed out, goes forth — he of seer-wisdom.

sanskrit: pra-pra kṣayāya panyase janāya juṣṭo adruhe | vīty arṣa caniṣṭhayā ||
english: Forth and forth, beloved of the guileless people who are worthy of praise and destined for a home — flow onward most pleasingly.

sanskrit: sa sūnur mātarā śucir jāto jāte arocayat | mahān mahī ṛtāvṛdhā ||
english: That pure son, born, has illumined both his mothers as they came into being — great is he, and they are the two great ones who prosper Ṛta.

sanskrit: sa sapta dhītibhir hito nadyo ajinvad adruhaḥ | yā ekam akṣi vāvṛdhuḥ ||
english: He, sustained by seven songs of devotion, the guileless one has made the rivers rejoice — the rivers that have grown into the one eye.

sanskrit: tā abhi santam astṛtam mahe yuvānam ā dadhuḥ | indum indra tava vrate ||
english: They have placed Indu — the ever-present, unconquered, great, youthful one — within thy ordinance, O Indra.

sanskrit: abhi vahnir amartyaḥ sapta paśyati vāvahiḥ | krivir devīr atarpayat ||
english: The immortal bearer, ever-moving, looks upon the seven; the active one has gratified the divine ones.

sanskrit: avā kalpeṣu naḥ pumas tamāṁsi soma yodhyā | tāni punāna jaṅghanaḥ ||
english: Help us, O Soma, in our proper rites, O manly one; fight away the darknesses; smite them while purifying thyself.

sanskrit: nū navyase navīyase sūktāya sādhayā pathaḥ | pratnavad rocayā rucaḥ ||
english: Now, for the newest, most recent, well-spoken hymn, make smooth the paths; illuminate the brilliances as of old.

sanskrit: pavamāna mahi śravo gām aśvaṁ rāsi vīravat ||  sanā medhāṁ sanā svaḥ ||
english: O Pavamāna, give us great fame, cows, and horses together with heroes; give us wisdom of old and the heavenly light of old.

sanskrit: pra svānāso rathā ivārvanto na śravasyavaḥ | somāso rāye akramuḥ ||
english: Sounding forth like chariots, eager for glory like swift steeds, the Somas have stepped forth toward wealth.

sanskrit: hinvānāso rathā iva dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ | bharāsaḥ kāriṇām iva ||
english: Urged on like chariots, they have run forward upon the arms of the presser, like the loads of toiling men.

sanskrit: rājāno na praśastibhiḥ somāso gobhir añjate | yajño na sapta dhātṛbhiḥ ||
english: Like kings with their praises, the Somas anoint themselves with the cows' milk; like a sacrifice with the seven dispensers.

sanskrit: pari suvānāsa indavo madāya barhaṇā girā | sutā arṣanti dhārayā ||
english: The pressed Indu-drops, pressed out, flow in a stream for exhilaration, with a mighty song.

sanskrit: āpānāso vivasvato jananta uṣaso bhagam | sūrā aṇvaṁ vi tanvate ||
english: Having drunk of Vivasvat's gift, they have given birth to the good fortune of the Dawns; the heroes spread the subtle one wide.

sanskrit: apa dvārā matīnām pratnā ṛṇvanti kāravāḥ | vṛṣṇo harasa āyavaḥ ||
english: The singers, devoted men of the bull, open wide the ancient doors of inspired thoughts with the fiery glow of the bull.

sanskrit: samīcīnāsa āsate hotāraḥ saptajāmayaḥ | padam ekasya pippataḥ ||
english: The seven kindred priests, facing one another, sit; they fill the footstep of the one.

sanskrit: nābhā nābhiṁ na ā dade cakṣuś cit sūrye sacā | kaver apatyam ā duhe ||
english: Hub to hub they joined together; even the eye accompanies the Sun; from the offspring of the seer they milk out the blessing.

sanskrit: abhi priyā divas padam adhvaryubhir guhā hitam | sūraḥ paśyati cakṣasā ||
english: With the eyes of the sun, the loved ones behold the seat of heaven set in secret by the adhvaryu priests.
